text:
Ajay: starting canary rollout for release v2.14.4 -> eu-west. start traffic 8% for 20m. DeployBot, initiate healthwatch. @Maria @Kevin FYI
DeployBot: DEPLOY STARTED canary_id=cb-1717009876 release=v2.14.4 env=eu-west traffic=8% window=20m
ObservabilityBot: baseline SLOs at start: embed_p95=78ms (SLO=100ms), errors_5m=0.28% (SLO=0.5%), token_rate=1.3k rps. dashboard: https://console.redwood/s/dash/1717009876
Maria: noticing a tail on /generate-embeds ~240ms from hosts in eu-west-2b, no 5xx. sample: ```host=eu-west-2b service=embed latency=240ms trace_id=abc123```
Kevin: this release includes a quant tweak and a KV cache change — could be coldness. Can we reduce traffic to 4% and watch mem/gpu?
Tara: rollback guardrails: p95 > 320ms OR 5xx > 0.9% sustained 2m. Also watch kvcache_miss and kernel_qps on GPU nodes.
Ajay: throttling to 4% now. @DeployBot set-traffic 8->4
DeployBot: traffic updated to 4%
ObservabilityBot: 3m check: embed_p95=210ms, errors_5m=0.4%, kvcache_miss=high on subset, gpu_mem=70%
Maria: KV miss looks correlated with hosts where quant files didn't warm yet. Logs show kv_restore events.
Kevin: propose a temporary route pin for embed to v2.14.3-quant for canary users. snippet: ```route "embed" if canary -> model:v2.14.3-quant```
Tara: +1 to pin, but we should note it in release notes and follow-up to improve warmup script. After pin, wait 6m to confirm.
Ajay: applying pin. @DeployBot apply-route-pin embed canary v2.14.3-quant
DeployBot: route pin applied. traffic still 4%
ObservabilityBot: 6m after pin: embed_p95=88ms, errors_5m=0.2%, gpu_mem=65% — SLOs restored :white_check_mark:
Ajay: ramping to 30% over 4m. adding note: temporarily pinned embed route in canary due to KV warmup regression. Follow-up task: improve KV warmup in rollout docs.
Maria: added trace links and sample logs to the release checklist.
Kevin: filing ticket INF-1420 to add proactive warmup job during canary initializers.
Tara: closing watch unless any alert within next 30m. Great catch.
